name: SAML role trust narrowed by a specific subject attribute (saml:sub) -> does NOT fire the high expansion finding (boundary)
note: IAM-804 boundary: a SAML attribute condition (saml:sub) bound to a specific subject narrows the federated subject, analogous to a tight OIDC sub. TRUST-FEDERATED is still emitted (a federated relationship exists) but at low/medium - it must NOT reach HIGH. saml:aud is recognized as a constraint. Target-role permissions remain out of scope / unknown.
